blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Megawide Construction Corp. has bagged P12.8 billion in contracts for two government housing projects in September, moving towards its P60-billion year-end order book target. On Tuesday, the Edgar Saavedra-led construction and engineering firm said the contracts cover 8,300 units under the government’s Expanded Pambansang Pabahay Para sa Pilipino (4PH) Program. READ: Megawide primed for P28.3-B revenues from 4PH venture Additionally these comprise the P6.9-billion, 3,800-unit Nocal Residences in North Caloocan and the P5.9-billion, 4,500-unit Sumi Residences in Imus, Cavite.
